title: Read-only container candidate report
description:
Add `jit archive candidates` as a read-only consumer of the shared container planner. Enumerate terminal issues whose configured type is at a non-leaf hierarchy level, use resolved-hierarchy membership, and evaluate each candidate fully with three-state policy status, managed/permanent/archive-root status, repository-wide direct and embedded ownership, action counts, evidence, and all applicable blockers. Do not hardcode type names, use categories, apply retention/age filtering, defer destination-conflict checks, or mutate files, issues, or events. JSON follows `schema_version: 1` with `count` and `candidates` per the repository list-envelope convention, each candidate carrying the complete schema-version-1 target plan envelope (artifacts, actions, evidence, warnings, blockers). Human output must report the same evaluated results and explain ineligible candidates rather than omit them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every terminal configured container is listed with policy status, ownership, action counts, evidence, warnings, and blockers; ineligible candidates are included with explanations.
- [hard] REQ-02: Human and JSON views represent identical evaluated candidate results, apply no age/retention filter, and produce no filesystem, issue, or event mutation.
- [hard] REQ-03: Candidate container-ness derives only from non-leaf levels of the live type hierarchy and membership from resolved hierarchy, with no hardcoded type names or raw dependency-closure membership.
- [hard] REQ-04: Every candidate is fully evaluated, including mirrored destination conflicts, with no category input, suggestion, guessed default, or deferred check when explicit inputs exist.
- [hard] REQ-05: JSON uses `{"schema_version":1,"count":N,"candidates":[...]}` and preserves each candidate's `configured`, `incomplete`, or `unconfigured` policy status.
- [hard] REQ-06: Candidate details distinguish `unmanaged-selected-root` blockers from `unmanaged-path` evidence on embedded dependencies; unmanaged embedded dependencies summarize only as copy or retain, never move.
- [hard] REQ-07: Archive-root sources, including retired `dev/archive/features/...` layouts, are marked already-existing rather than unmanaged: direct roots retain at existing paths, relative-edge dependencies of relocated parents copy to the mirror while originals remain, and root-relative or staying-parent dependencies retain.
